title: Charge Robotics (YC S21) Is Hiring Software and Hardware Engineers
summary: Charge Robotics, a Y Combinator Summer 2021 batch company, is recruiting software and hardware engineers to join their team. The company focuses on robotics development and is leveraging the YC network for talent acquisition.
problem_solved: This job posting addresses the hiring needs of a robotics startup seeking qualified engineering talent to build and scale their robotic products.
why_valuable: As a YC-backed company, Charge Robotics offers candidates the opportunity to work on cutting-edge robotics projects with startup-level equity upside and growth potential.
